title: Human Development: Definition, Nature & Principles
summary: Human development defined as the pattern of change that begins at conception and continues through the life span. Covers nature, principles, domains (physical, cognitive, social-emotional) and periods of development.
revision: Human development: definition, domains (physical, cognitive, social-emotional) and lifespan periods.
traps: Development = change from conception through life span.

notes.t: The pattern of change that begins at conception and continues through the life span, involving growth, change and stability in physical, cognitive and social-emotional domains.
Development is lifelong, multidimensional, multidirectional, plastic, multidisciplinary and contextual.

i: Physical development: body, brain, senses, motor skills, health
Cognitive development: thinking, intelligence, language, memory
Infancy and toddlerhood: birth to 2 years

notes.t: UGC NET frequently asks about the definition of development, its domains and periods across the lifespan.

mnemonics.title: LMDPC
mnemonics.text: L — Lifelong, M — Multidimensional, D — Multidirectional, P — Plastic, C — Contextual

flashcards.a: Pattern of change from conception through the life span.
